title: Translate CWL workflow to Snakemake
description:
Direct translation of CWL-based eCLIP repeat element mapping pipeline to Snakemake. Strategy: prompts/translate_cwl.md.

Steps:
1. Generate downsampled SE/PE test datasets (examples/inputs/downsampled/)
2. Run CWL pipeline on test data to get expected outputs
3. Write Snakemake workflow (Snakefile + SE.smk/PE.smk/common.smk)
4. Verify Snakemake outputs match CWL outputs on small and full datasets
5. Cleanup (README, remove unused CWL/Perl)

Branch: cwl-to-snakemake
Key constraint: Snakemake outputs must match CWL outputs exactly.

title: Reference data generation (mm10/mm39)
description:
Generate parsed_ucsc_tableformat, bowtie2_index, UniqueGenomicElements.bed, and MASTER_FILELIST for mm10 and mm39 assemblies using Python scripts in bin/python/refdata_generation/.

STATUS: ~95% complete. Scripts written and committed. Outputs generated in examples/inputs/{mm10,mm39}/. Remaining: run hg38 reproduction validation tests (T-03, T-05, T-07, T-09) to confirm accuracy, then integration test.

Resume: git checkout refdata-generation
